decision_split.note: All candidate ground actions from one state remain in the same split; action-level leakage is forbidden.

cell: DOVOD one-sided 95% exact holdout risk bound
primary_endpoints.aggregate: domain-mean test-risk improvement against both upstream and global-override comparators
primary_endpoints.confirmatory_test: two-sided exact sign tests over 20 domain means for DOVOD-vs-base and DOVOD-vs-global-override
primary_endpoints.failure_policy: Every frozen learner/domain/budget cell remains in the denominator. Timeout, dependency, parse, learner, or evaluation failures are explicit failed cells.

claim_boundary: Protocol frozen before external outcomes. DOVOD repairs applicability decisions only. No claim about effect correctness, plan validity, physical safety, or authoritative mechanical necessity follows from this benchmark.
